question: Which beautiful bird with colorful feathers is the National Bird of India? 🦚
explanation: Great job! The peacock is our National Bird and is famous for its bright, beautiful feathers that it spreads when it rains! 🦚
hint: It loves to dance in the rain.

question: What is the name of our country? 🇮🇳
explanation: Awesome! Our country is named India, which is a land of great culture and diversity! 🌍
hint: It starts with the letter 'I'.

question: Which animal is the National Animal of India? 🐯
explanation: Super! The Royal Bengal Tiger is our National Animal because it is strong and brave! 🦁
hint: It has black stripes on its orange body.

question: How many colors are in our National Flag? 🏳️
explanation: Fantastic! Our flag is called the Tiranga because it has three main colors: saffron, white, and green! 🏳️
hint: The word 'Tiranga' means three colors.

question: Which color is at the top of our National Flag? 🧡
explanation: Great job! Saffron is at the top, and it stands for courage and sacrifice! 🧡
hint: It looks like the color of an orange.

question: What is the color of the wheel (Ashoka Chakra) in our flag? 🔵
explanation: Awesome! The Ashoka Chakra in the middle is navy blue and it stands for progress! ☸️
hint: It is the color of the sky and the sea.

question: Which is the National Flower of India? 🪷
explanation: Super! The beautiful lotus flower growing in water is our National Flower! 🪷
hint: It grows in muddy ponds.

question: In which city is the capital of India located? 🏙️
explanation: Fantastic! New Delhi is the capital city of India where many important offices are! 🏛️
hint: It is a very big city in North India.

question: What is our National Song called? 🎶
explanation: Great job! Vande Mataram is our National Song that fills us with pride for our motherland! 🇮🇳
hint: It starts with the letter 'V'.

question: What is the name of our National Anthem? 🎼
explanation: Awesome! Jana Gana Mana is our National Anthem, written by Rabindranath Tagore! 📝
hint: We stand up when we sing it.

question: Which festival is known as the 'Festival of Lights'? 🪔
explanation: Super! Diwali is the festival of lights where we light up our homes with lamps! ✨
hint: We burn crackers and diyas.

question: Which festival is known as the 'Festival of Colors'? 🌈
explanation: Fantastic! Holi is the festival of colors where we play and have fun with our friends! 🎨
hint: We throw colorful powder at each other.

question: Which of these is a harvest festival celebrated in Punjab? 🌾
explanation: Great job! Baisakhi is a joyful harvest festival celebrated by people in Punjab! 🥁
hint: People dance the Bhangra here.

question: Where is the famous Taj Mahal located? 🕌
explanation: Awesome! The beautiful white marble Taj Mahal is in Agra! 🏛️
hint: It was built by Shah Jahan.

question: Which river is considered the most holy river in India? 🌊
explanation: Super! The Ganga is our sacred river that flows through many states in India! 🏞️
hint: It starts from the mountains.

question: Which mountain range is in the north of India? 🏔️
explanation: Fantastic! The mighty Himalayas are in the north and have the highest peaks in the world! ❄️
hint: They are covered with snow.

question: Which of these is the National Game of India? 🏑
explanation: Great job! Field Hockey is traditionally considered our National Game because of our history of winning! 🏆
hint: We use a stick and a ball.

question: Which language is spoken by the most people in India? 🗣️
explanation: Awesome! Hindi is the most spoken language across many parts of our country! 🇮🇳
hint: It is written in Devanagari script.

question: What is the color at the bottom of our flag? 💚
explanation: Super! Green is at the bottom, and it represents our lush fields and farming! 🌿
hint: It is the color of leaves.

question: Which festival marks the end of Ramadan? 🌙
explanation: Fantastic! Eid-ul-Fitr is celebrated at the end of the holy month of Ramadan with yummy food! 🍛
hint: It is celebrated after a month of fasting.

question: Which of these is a famous festival of Kerala? 🛶
explanation: Great job! Onam is a famous festival in Kerala where people have boat races! ⛵
hint: It is a harvest festival of Kerala.

question: India is divided into many smaller parts called what? 🗺️
explanation: Awesome! India is a very big country and is divided into many states, each with its own beauty! 🇮🇳
hint: Every state has its own government.

question: Which fruit is the National Fruit of India? 🥭
explanation: Super! The tasty and juicy mango is the National Fruit of India! 🥭
hint: It is called the King of fruits.

question: Which is the smallest state of India? 📍
explanation: Fantastic! Goa is the smallest state in India and is famous for its beautiful beaches! 🏖️
hint: It is very popular for holidays.

question: Which day do we celebrate Independence Day? 🗓️
explanation: Great job! We celebrate our Independence Day on 15 August every year! 🇮🇳
hint: This is when India became free.

question: Which of these is a famous dance of Punjab? 🥁
explanation: Awesome! Bhangra is a high-energy dance from Punjab that everyone loves! 🥁
hint: It is a very fast and fun dance.

question: Which festival is celebrated on 2nd October every year? 👴
explanation: Super! 2nd October is the birthday of Mahatma Gandhi, the Father of our Nation! 👴
hint: He is called Bapu.

question: Which city is known as the 'Pink City'? 🏰
explanation: Fantastic! Jaipur is famously known as the Pink City because of its beautiful pink buildings! 🏰
hint: It is in the state of Rajasthan.

question: What are the colors of our National Flag together called? 🏳️
explanation: Great job! We call our flag 'Tiranga' because 'Tri' means three and 'Ranga' means color! 🏳️
hint: It has three colors.

question: Which state is famous for its tea gardens? 🍃
explanation: Awesome! Assam is famous for its beautiful green tea gardens and hills! 🍃
hint: This state is in North-East India.

question: Which of these is a festival of lights and decorations? 🪔
explanation: Super! Diwali is the festival where we clean our houses and decorate them with lamps! 🪔
hint: It brings joy and light.

question: Which animal is used to carry heavy loads in deserts? 🐫
explanation: Fantastic! The camel is called the 'Ship of the Desert' and can walk easily on sand! 🐫
hint: It has a hump on its back.

question: What is the famous food of Punjab? 🍛
explanation: Great job! Makki-di-roti and Sarson-ka-saag is a super yummy meal from Punjab! 🍛
hint: It is made of corn flour.

question: Which of these is a major festival of South India? 🥘
explanation: Awesome! Pongal is a harvest festival celebrated in South India with a delicious dish! 🥘
hint: It is very popular in Tamil Nadu.

question: In which direction does the sun rise? 🌅
explanation: Super! The sun always rises in the East every single morning! 🌅
hint: It is the opposite of West.

question: Which of these is a popular dance form of Gujarat? 💃
explanation: Fantastic! Garba is a fun dance where people move in circles during Navratri! 💃
hint: People use sticks (Dandiya) for this.

question: What is the national motto of India? 🦁
explanation: Great job! Satyameva Jayate means 'Truth Alone Triumphs' and is our national motto! 🦁
hint: It is written under the national emblem.

question: Where is the Gateway of India located? 🌉
explanation: Awesome! The Gateway of India is a famous monument standing tall in Mumbai! 🌉
hint: It is near the Arabian Sea.

question: Which of these is the National Tree of India? 🌳
explanation: Super! The Banyan tree is our National Tree, known for its long, spreading branches! 🌳
hint: It has many hanging roots.

question: Which festival is celebrated as the birthday of Guru Nanak Dev Ji? 🕯️
explanation: Fantastic! Guru Purab is a very special day celebrated by Sikhs all over the country! 🕯️
hint: People go to Gurudwaras.

question: Which is the longest river in the world that flows through India? 🌊
explanation: Great job! The Ganga is the longest river in India and is very special to all of us! 🌊
hint: It flows into the Bay of Bengal.

question: Which of these is a popular dance from North India (Lucknow/Delhi)? 🩰
explanation: Awesome! Kathak is a graceful classical dance form from North India! 🩰
hint: It involves fast footwork.

question: Who is known as the 'Father of the Nation' in India? 👴
explanation: Super! Mahatma Gandhi is remembered with love as the Father of our Nation! 👴
hint: He taught us non-violence.

question: Which state is known as the 'Land of Five Rivers'? 🌾
explanation: Fantastic! Punjab is called the 'Land of Five Rivers' because five rivers flow through it! 🌾
hint: It is in North-West India.

question: Which festival marks the victory of good over evil (Dussehra)? 🏹
explanation: Great job! Dussehra is celebrated to mark the victory of Lord Rama over Ravana! 🏹
hint: People burn the effigies of Ravana.

question: What is the national emblem of India taken from? 🦁
explanation: Awesome! Our national emblem is taken from the top of the Ashoka Pillar at Sarnath! 🦁
hint: It has four lions.

question: Which of these is a famous desert in India? 🏜️
explanation: Super! The Thar Desert is a beautiful sandy desert located mostly in Rajasthan! 🏜️
hint: It is also known as the Great Indian Desert.

question: Which day is celebrated as Republic Day in India? 🇮🇳
explanation: Fantastic! We celebrate our Republic Day on 26 January when our Constitution started! 🇮🇳
hint: There is a big parade in Delhi.

question: What is the main language of Kerala? 🥥
explanation: Great job! Malayalam is the official language spoken by people in Kerala! 🥥
hint: It is a beautiful South Indian language.

question: Which monument in Delhi was built to honor Indian soldiers? 🇮🇳
explanation: Awesome! India Gate is a grand monument in Delhi built in memory of our brave soldiers! 🇮🇳
hint: It looks like an arch.
